## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits (e.g. `feat(backend): add readiness probe`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and they pass locally
- [ ] Docs updated in this same PR (README, ADRs, concepts, API contract) where behaviour changed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or personal data in the diff or the history
- [ ] For AI features: evaluation impact considered (quality, regressions) and threats considered (prompt injection, data leakage, cost abuse)
